name: io.github.Odingard/guardian-mcp
title: Guardian by Odingard
description: Puts Guardian in front of MCP tool calls: allow, ask a person, or deny before the call runs.

environmentVariables.name: GUARDIAN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Guardian API base URL, e.g. https://guardian-api-azure.odingard.com

environmentVariables.name: GUARDIAN_AGENT_CREDENTIAL
environmentVariables.description: Agent credential (gak_…) from the Guardian console

environmentVariables.name: GUARDIAN_CONNECTION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Tool connection id (pcn_…); required for proxy mode
